how-to-play:
**How to play Alliance:**
Alliance is a game of negotiation. Every tick, all living players will receive 1 Action Point (AP). AP allow you to do any one of five actions: 
1. Move one space in any cardinal direction
2. Attack any player within your reach
3. Heal 1 health
4. Expand your reach by 0.5
5. Donate 1 AP to any player within your reach

Every day, before the Tick, players must **DM** the Game Master bot (me) with their desired actions. These actions must be confirmed using !confirm, or else they will be discarded before the Tick. Actions are queued up and carried out on the Tick *in the order they are confirmed*, meaning timing of the actions is vital to some plays.

What happens between the Ticks is up to the players. The winner of the game is the last player alive. This can not be achieved alone.

Good luck.
